notes.title: Update 3.08
notes.content:
[h3][Update Details][/h3]
[*]Correction of typos and errors
[*]Other minor bugs...
[*]Chinese support (display Chinese account only)
[/list]

[h3][Announcement][/h3]
[b]I translated script into English by myself, since I lost contract with a translator. I did my best, but please feel free to send me your comment if you find my mistranslations. Thank you.[/b]


The "Vertical Synchronization (VSync)" setting is intended for those who[b] feel the game tempo is significantly faster.[/b]
If you are comfortable with the gameplay, please keep the default setting (recommended).

For more information on "Vertical Synchronization (VSync)", please refer to the following.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2134176268
